paragraphs.text: Surr is a desert country of uncertain location on Dominaria .
It is known for its great burial pyramids, and its inhabitants ritually scar their faces. Not long before the Phyrexian Invasion , Surr was invaded by Keld .

While there are slaves in Keld who are identified as Surrans, and "Surran burial pyramids" and "Surran ritual face scarring" are referenced, the actual name of their home of origin has never been revealed. It might as well be called Surra, or Surran.
